decoded.meaning: A kind = 0x16 escape record whose declared payload is SEVEN bytes, not eight. A PAIR is exactly a u32 index and a u32 generation (RFC-0029 5.1), so these bytes are a malformed ADDRESS: a hop refuses it with ERROR{tr::path::invalid} (0x0021) and MUST NOT read a short field as a pair. The FRAME is not refused - the record is self-delimiting, so every codec carries it and a hop that does not implement kind 0x16 steps over it by length.
decoded.note: Not a reject.bin case: a packed PATH body is opt.PL = 0, opaque to the codec, the same reasoning as path-label/label-wrong-length. The requirement is a RESOLVER requirement.
